_about: Yugi's welcome. tour: said once, the first time you land on a run's timeline, as a tap-through conversation. screens: said once each, the first time you open that screen (menu: the main menu; campaign: the run list; new-run: the new run form). Each line: key, mood, target (a CSS selector for what to spotlight while it's up; comma-separated alternatives, the first on screen wins), and its wording: 'solo'/'duo' by the run's mode, or 'guest'/'member' by the account, else 'text'. 'only' keeps a line to one of those. On phones, when the target is in the lower half, Yugi speaks from the top; on wider screens he moves to the right-hand corner when his own would cover it. {set} is the run's current set, {packs} its packs per set, {rival} the rival's duelist name. Lines stay under 140 characters.

tour.solo: This is your road through the history of the game. Each pack is a set, in the order they came out.
tour.duo: This is the road you and {rival} will walk together. Each pack is a set, in the order they came out.

tour.solo: We start at {set}, just like duelists did back then. Your deck can only use the cards you pull!
tour.duo: You both start at {set}, just like duelists did back then. Your decks can only use the cards you pull!

tour.solo: Each set, you open its {packs} packs once. Tap Open Packs when you're ready. The heart of the cards decides the rest!
tour.duo: Each set, you each open its {packs} packs once. You can't duel until {rival} has opened theirs too!

tour.solo: Then build a deck from what you pulled. You can duel right here, or export it and play wherever you like.
tour.duo: Then build a deck from what you pulled and duel {rival}: right here, or wherever you two like to play.

tour.solo: Tap Play / Record to duel right here, or to record a duel you played elsewhere. Win or lose, the road moves on.
tour.duo: Tap Play / Record to challenge {rival} here. Played elsewhere? One of you records it and the other confirms.

tour.solo: A win spins the reward wheel, and a loss still gets you three pity packs. Every duel makes your collection stronger!
tour.duo: The winner spins the reward wheel, the loser gets three pity packs. Every duel makes you both stronger!

tour.solo: That's all there is to it! Let's open some packs.
tour.duo: That's all there is to it! Let's open some packs before {rival} beats us to it.

menu.text: Hi, I'm Yugi! Welcome to the Progression Series. We'll relive the whole history of the card game, one set at a time.
To begin, pick Campaign Mode. That's where your runs live, and where you start a new one.

menu.guest: You're playing as a guest, so everything stays on this device. Sign in to keep it in an account and to duel a rival!
menu.member: You're signed in, so your runs follow you to any device. And you can challenge a rival to a duo run!

menu.text: Options has the sound, my typewriter and me. You can send me away there any time... but I hope you won't!

campaign.text: Your runs will wait here. Tap New Game to start one!

new-run.text: Solo is you against the sets. Duo brings a rival: invite them by their duelist name, or send them a link.
The starting set is where your road begins. Legend of Blue Eyes is the true start, but you can skip ahead.
Packs per set is how many you open each time. 24 is a whole booster box, 12 is tighter, 30 is generous.

packs.text: Here's this set's booster box! You can peek at the card list first, or open your packs right away.

haul.text: That's your haul! Save it to add the cards to your collection. A set's packs only open once, so enjoy them.

collection.text: Your binder! Every set gets its own chapter. Tap a card to read it, or search for anything you own.

deck-builder.text: Build your deck from the cards you own: up to three of each. Aim for 40 cards in the main deck.
When it's ready, export it as a YDK file and load it wherever you duel. Good luck!

record-match.solo: Tell me how the duel went! Win or lose, we move on to the next set together.
record-match.duo: Tell me how it went against {rival}! They'll confirm it, and then we both move on.

rewards.text: Your prizes wait here. Wins earn wheel spins, losses earn pity packs. Open them whenever you like!
A wildcard picks a card of its rarity or lower from the set you won it in. A Redoer Ticket rerolls a set's packs!
